headline: Finkurve Financial Services announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Board finalizes decisions for Finkurve Financial
summary: Finkurve Financial Services Limited informed the stock exchanges about the outcome of its board meeting held on October 01, 2026. The company submitted the required corporate filings regarding the meeting proceedings. Indian retail investors tracking Finkurve should review the official exchange disclosures for specific resolutions or corporate actions approved during the session.
why_it_matters: Check exchange filings for specific corporate actions.

headline: Finkurve Financial Services submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Post-AGM compliance filing from Finkurve Financial
summary: Finkurve Financial Services has officially submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. These documents provide the official breakdown of shareholder votes on resolutions presented during the meeting. This is a routine post-meeting compliance filing required for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review the approved resolutions in the exchange filings.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price

headline: Finkurve Financial Services announces NCD interest payment details
hook: Upcoming interest payout for NCD holders
summary: Finkurve Financial Services Limited has notified the exchange regarding the interest payment schedule for its Non-Convertible Debenture (NCD) holders. The record date for the payment is set for September 16, 2026. The notification covers specific ISINs, namely INE73I07057 and INE734I07040. This is a routine debt servicing update for existing debenture holders of the company.
why_it_matters: Interest credited to NCD holders on schedule.
